questions.question: In December 2020, the Reserve Bank launched a new edition of the Regulatory Sandbox. Which of the following is the theme of the program?
questions.explanation: The RBI's Regulatory Sandbox ran its first cohort on the theme 'Retail Payments'; the December 2020 test-phase announcements related to this retail payments cohort (the second cohort, on cross-border payments, was opened subsequently).

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: India and ADB signed a USD 231 million loan to augment electricity generation capacity in which of the following states?
questions.explanation: The Government of India and the Asian Development Bank signed a USD 231 million loan to augment electricity generation capacity in Assam (Lower Kopili Hydroelectric Power Project).

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Which bank announced the launch of 'Home Utsav'?
questions.explanation: ICICI Bank launched 'Home Utsav', a virtual property exhibition showcasing real-estate projects digitally (October 2020).

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) board finalised a three-year roadmap, Project 'UTKARSH'. It is meant for what purpose?
questions.explanation: Utkarsh 2022 is the RBI's medium-term strategy framework aimed at strengthening the bank's supervision and regulation functions, among other goals.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: In December 2020, which of the following banks launched a 3-in-1 account for saving, trading and demat?
questions.explanation: Equitas Small Finance Bank launched a 3-in-1 account combining savings, trading and demat facilities in December 2020.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: In July 2020, how much amount (in crore) was approved by the Union Cabinet for the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund?
questions.explanation: The Union Cabinet approved the Rs 1 lakh crore (1,00,000 crore) Agriculture Infrastructure Fund in July 2020 for post-harvest infrastructure and community farming assets.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Who was appointed the PM of Ivory Coast in July 2020?
questions.explanation: Hamed Bakayoko was appointed Prime Minister of Ivory Coast in July 2020 following the death of PM Amadou Gon Coulibaly.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Who was honoured with a Lifetime Achievement Award at the third edition of the India International Film Festival of Boston (IIFFB 2020)?
questions.explanation: As per the paper's answer key, veteran actor Om Puri was honoured (posthumously) with the Lifetime Achievement Award at IIFFB 2020.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Palle Pragathi yojana was launched by which state?
questions.explanation: Palle Pragathi is Telangana's rural development programme for cleaner, greener villages.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: In which country did PM Narendra Modi inaugurate the Mangdechhu hydroelectric power plant in August 2019?
questions.explanation: PM Modi inaugurated the 720 MW Mangdechhu hydroelectric project in Bhutan during his August 2019 visit; it was built with Indian assistance.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)
